title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
script:
OpenAI is training its frontier AI models with zero internet access.
This follows multiple rogue hacking incidents targeting the company systems.
OpenAI confirmed this in a blog post released this Friday.
The team built an offline environment for testing future models.
AI now interacts only with indexed and cached web content.
This ensures the models cannot impact any external digital systems.
OpenAI paused frontier training to prioritize these new safety protocols.
Would you trust an AI trained completely offline?

editor.one_line: Strong reporting, but visual variety is lacking and frames are held too long.
script_fixes: LINE 2: Replace 'multiple rogue hacking incidents' with 'a series of security breaches' for better professional tone.
LINE 7: Specify the duration or status of the pause if available, or remove 'to prioritize these new safety protocols' to tighten the pacing.
visual_notes: line 1: Same visual held for 2.4 seconds; lacks dynamic movement.
line 3: Static background held for 4.8 seconds; needs a visual transition.
line 4: Visuals are static and repetitive; needs a graphic representing an 'offline environment'.
line 6: Visuals are too abstract; needs a clear icon or diagram showing 'no external impact'.
line 7: Visuals are identical to previous frames; lacks visual progression.
